Don’t Take Chances with Your Faulty Furnace

When your heating system is on the fritz, there's more to worry about than an uncomfortably chilly home. Even if it's still producing heat, your system may be operating less efficiently than usual. In addition to wasting energy, this can increase wear and tear and lead to more extensive damage. You could even be exposed to harmful fumes if there's an issue with your flue pipe or heat exchanger. It's always best to schedule repairs at the first sign of trouble, especially if your heater.

• Blowing cool air or not producing much airflow
  • Making worrying noises or emitting strange odors
  • Cycling on and off in short, frequent bursts
  • Burning with a yellow or flickering flame
  • Using much more energy than usual
  • Repeatedly tripping its circuit breaker
